title: Supplier Geometry Package
description: Defines a validated supplier geometry package used to promote case templates from prototype to production status.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for v1 of the supplier geometry package format.

package_id.description: Unique identifier for this geometry package. Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens and underscores. Test fixtures must start with 'test-' or 'fixture-'.

supplier_id.description: Identifier for the supplier who provided this geometry.

supplier_reference.description: Supplier's own reference (SKU, part number, or file reference) for this geometry.

device_id.description: Device ID from the device registry, e.g. 'iphone-17e'.

case_type.description: Case type (Contract v1 token). Must match a valid Contract v1 case type: hard, tough, magsafe, clear, soft.

revision.description: Revision identifier for this geometry version (e.g. 'v1', 'revA', '2025-03-15').

source_type.description: Type of source geometry provided by the supplier.

name.description: Filename of the source file inside the source/ directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source file.

source_files.description: List of source files provided by the supplier, each with its SHA-256 hash.

dimensions.description: Physical or pixel dimensions of the case geometry.

geometry_notes.description: Free-form notes about the geometry (edge cases, special handling, known discrepancies, etc.).

obtained_from.description: How/where this geometry was obtained (supplier contact, portal download, email, etc.).

verified_by.description: Owner who reviewed and verified this geometry package. Must be non-empty and not a sentinel value.

reviewed.description: Whether this package has been owner-reviewed. MUST be true for production promotion.

target_template_id.description: The template ID this package targets, in device_id__case_type__view format.

normalized_geometry.description: Normalized geometry metadata for the exported layers.

print_region.description: Printable area within the canvas (in canvas pixels).

camera_region.description: Optional camera/module exclusion area within the canvas (in canvas pixels).

file.description: Filename of the layer PNG inside the normalized/ directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the layer file.

role.description: Layer role in the template compositing stack.

normalized_layers.description: List of normalized PNG layers ready for use in a case template.
